rulings.ruling: The R7,628.30 receipt that moves is COF001 payment 30219 (2024-03-12, STAT:101), not 29492. The ERP agent reverses 30219 in COF001 and re-posts it to COF002, against the unpaid COF002 invoice 31096 (2024-04-08, R7,628.30). Nothing else changes.
rulings.basis: Operator ruling. NOT proven by the analysis: the ledger alone favoured 29492 on timing (30219 is dated 27 days before invoice 31096, COF002 normally pays 2 to 10 days after delivery; 29492 is dated 10 days after). ERP payment tags carry no evidential weight (business_rules.md sections 3 and 15). The analyst did not rank the two receipts.
